  reportOverviewDetailDTOObjectNoToday's data.
    spendStringNoSpend is the total amount spent.
    impressionsNumberNoAn impression is counted when your promoted product is shown. Impressions help you understand how often your promoted product is being seen.
    clicksNumberNoA click is counted when someone clicks on your promoted product.
    ctrStringNoClickthrough rate (CTR) measures how often people click on your promoted product after it's shown to them, which can help you understand the effectiveness of your promoted product.
    unitsSoldNumberNoThe total number of units sold after someone clicks your promoted product.
    revenueStringNoThe revenue generated from units sold after someone clicks your promoted product. It is the total buyer paid amount inclusive of all discounts applied, store credit, shipping fees and surcharges.

    roiStringNoThe store's return on investment (ROI) shows how efficient your Sponsored Discovery's spend is in driving revenue for your store.
